title: Extending the erased interval
statement: Let $d$ be a tape of optional Boolean symbols, let $\ell$ be an integer, and let $j$ be a nonnegative integer. Updating the tape obtained by erasing the first $j$ cells of $[\ell,\infty)$ to be blank at cell $\ell+j$ gives the tape obtained by erasing the first $j+1$ cells.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a tape of optional Boolean symbols
replaced:
For every data tape $d$, integer $\ell$, and count $j$, blanking the cell $\ell + j$ of
the tape obtained from $d$ by erasing the first $j$ interval cells yields the tape
obtained from $d$ by erasing the first $j + 1$ interval cells.
